items.prompt: Where is the origin (0,0) of Manim's default coordinate system?
options: At the centre of the screen.
items.explanation: Manim's coordinate system is centred on screen; UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT are unit vectors from that centre, not pixel offsets from a corner.

items.prompt: You need to clean up a scene that contains shapes and a Text caption. Which call is correct?
items.explanation: A scene can hold non-VMobject types (Text/captions). Group accepts mixed Mobject types; VGroup accepts only compatible VMobjects. So Group(*self.mobjects) is the safe cleanup.

items.prompt: Complete the call to place label directly below row with a gap: label.______(row, DOWN, buff=0.8)
items.explanation: next_to(mobject, direction, buff=...) positions one mobject relative to another's bounding box. move_to uses absolute coords; arrange lays out a group.

items.prompt: What is the value of row[1] after this runs?
items.explanation: VGroup preserves insertion order. arrange() repositions the existing children but does not reorder them, so row[1] is still the Square.

items.prompt: Find the broken line and choose the fix.
items.code:
caption = Text("note")
vg = VGroup(Circle(), caption)
vg.arrange(RIGHT)
self.play(Create(vg))
options: Use Group instead of VGroup when mixing Text with shapes.
items.explanation: Line 2 puts a Text (not a compatible VMobject for VGroup in all versions) into a VGroup. Mixing types calls for Group, which accepts any Mobject.

items.prompt: Order these steps to build and clean up a labelled diagram.
options: Create the shapes and arrange them into a VGroup.
Position the group with to_edge or next_to.
Create the group on screen with self.play(Create(group)).
items.explanation: Build -> position -> reveal -> clean exit. You cannot meaningfully position before creating the mobjects, and you must reveal before cleanup.

items.prompt: Write a scene with three shapes arranged vertically, a title above them, and a clean exit. Paste it and self-score.
items.modelAnswer:
from manim import *

class VerticalThree(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#1C1C1C"
        title = Text("three shapes", font_size=40).to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        col = VGroup(Circle(0.5, color=BLUE), Square(side_length=1.0, color=YELLOW),
                     Triangle(color=GREEN)).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5)
        col.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        self.play(Write(title), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Create(col), run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(Group(*self.mobjects)), run_time=0.6)

rubric.criterion: A title positioned above, not overlapping.
Uses arrange(DOWN) and next_to/to_edge (no pixel guessing).

items.explanation: The model arranges with arrange/next_to, pauses after reveals, and cleans up with Group.
